title: Como 1907 Takes on Brescia in Coppa Italia
seoTitle: Como 1907 vs Brescia: Coppa Italia Women Clash
subtitle: The clash marks the BiancoBlu's return to the competition and prepares the team for their Serie A Women debut.
excerpt: Como 1907 returns to the Coppa Italia Women against Brescia CF in a match that could define their campaign's continuity and preparation for their Serie A debut.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Como 1907 Femminile returned to the field, one day before their Serie A Women debut, and their next challenge will be against Brescia CF in the first round of the Coppa Italia Women. The match, scheduled for 3 PM, could decide if the BiancoBlu advance to face Lazio in the next round.

What Changes When the BiancoBlu Take the Field

With a 0–1 victory in the first leg, thanks to a goal from Colombo, Como has already demonstrated its ability to overcome high-level opponents. In the return leg, the team led by Selena Mazzantini took a 2–0 lead, thanks to goals from Giacinti and Rizza, before a goal from Cavicchia reduced the difference to 2–1. The victory ensures their passage to the next round.

Como Prepares for the Clash with Brescia

Brescia's coach, Damiano Zenoni, will take the field after losing the Serie B Femminile match against Genoa. The club, which features experienced players from the division, seeks to consolidate its Coppa Italia campaign. The BiancoBlu, on the other hand, aim to maintain consistency and solidify their identity before the start of the season.

Impact on the Serie A Women Trajectory

The result of this match will determine if Como advances in the Coppa Italia and, consequently, if they will have the opportunity to face Lazio in the second round. Furthermore, the match serves as critical preparation for their Serie A Women debut, allowing the team to test their strategy and cohesion on the field.

What to Expect from the Duel

Brescia's coach emphasized that the clash will demand focus, personality, intensity, and team spirit. For Como, the goal is to demonstrate discipline and leverage accumulated experience to overcome their opponent and advance in the tournament.

Summary of Statistics from the Last Encounter

  • Colombo's goal in the first leg (Como 0–1 Brescia).
  • Giacinti and Rizza's goals in the second leg (Como 2–0 Brescia).
  • Cavicchia scored the only goal in the second leg (Como 2–1 Brescia).
  • Como maintained the advantage and advanced to the next round.

With information from Como 1907, BBC.
